correctness.rationale: For odd carousel R_{2h+1}, an oriented pair has interval counts a=d−1,b=h−d, hence a+b=h−1. Rank-r three-variable inductive formulas A_{r,s},B_{r,s} express a or b≥s for every s≤2^r−1 by splitting an appropriate interval at a third vertex. Rank-q existential pair sentences distinguish every h below 2^{q−1}−1. For the upper bound, a q-round EF game on a doubled cyclic array with antipodal markers maintains marked order, parity, and exact-or-large gap thresholds L_r=2^{r+1}−1; any split of a large same-parity gap is matched at threshold L_{r−1}, giving partial isomorphism. This proves all FO rank-q agreement beyond n=2^q−1; FO3 lower witnesses match it. Independent combinatorial enumeration of both split identities checked 27,014 triples of pairs in n≤25, not a substitute for the unbounded EF invariant.
residual_risks: Scope is pure arc-relation finite odd-order carousel tournaments, not arbitrary locally transitive tournaments, counting logic or named cyclic order.
The small finite check verifies combinatorial splits but not the full all-round EF strategy; the proof supplies that.
